c.title: $4,250 / 2br - 900ft2 - Fully Furnished 2BR Kitsilano Garden Suite – 90+ Days – Utilities Incl (Kitsilano)
c.description:
Beautiful, fully furnished 2-bedroom garden suite in a renovated Craftsman home in the heart of Kitsilano.

$4,250/month for shorter stays, including furnishings, all utilities and high-speed internet. Reduced monthly rates are available for longer stays of 3–6 months or more — please enquire with your dates for the best available rate.

Available for stays of 90 days or longer. Particularly well suited to professionals, couples, small families, relocations, visiting academics, people renovating or between homes, or anyone looking for a comfortable furnished home in Vancouver for several months.

The private, self-contained suite is approximately 850–900 sq ft and includes:

• 2 bedrooms
• Fully furnished throughout
• Full kitchen with stainless steel appliances
• In-suite washer & dryer
• Private entrance
• Private outdoor patio
• Blackout blinds
• Portable A/C
• High-speed internet
• All utilities included
• Free street parking – no permit required

Located on a quiet, tree-lined residential street in Kitsilano, close to Kitsilano Beach, Jericho Beach, shops, cafés, restaurants, parks and transit, with convenient access to both UBC and downtown Vancouver.

The suite is part of our beautifully renovated character home and offers a quiet, comfortable and private place to stay while still being in one of Vancouver's most desirable neighbourhoods.

Minimum stay: 90 days
Longer stays: Very welcome, with reduced monthly rates
Furnished: Yes
Utilities & internet: Included
Parking: Free street parking, no permit required
Pets: A small, well-behaved dog may be considered

When enquiring, please tell me a little about yourself, who would be staying in the suite, your preferred move-in date and how long you're looking to rent.
